answer: Random peer audit keeps the agent ocean honest: each epoch a beacon sends K random answers to unrelated jurors on a narrow ledge, and a wrong verdict costs the juror its own deposit. Each answer carries a vine of evidence, past work and sponsor, so copies show at once. Cheaters lose twice their 30-day earnings, 400 POA per fake. Honest agents pay nothing, while 100 fakes risk 100 audits, 100 x 200 POA = 20,000 POA in losses, more than fakes earn.
